notes.title: Party PooperZ v1.2.0
notes.content:
[h1]Hello There Party PooperZ![/h1]

Version 1.2.0 is live and brings some more improvements to the party!

[list]
[*] Fixed UI back button bug
[*] Fixed bug where settings didn't apply correctly
[*] Tweaked some audio
[*] Added voice lines to NPC
[*] Bottle now ignores NPC's so you can hit other players more easily
[*] Added effect to shoe item
[*] Improved some UI elements
[*] Throwing NPC now also adds player velocity to throw
[*] NPC's can no longer be grabbed while airborne
[/list]

notes.title: Party PooperZ v1.1.0
notes.content:
[h1]Hello There Party PooperZ![/h1]

Version 1.1.0 is now live and brings in a bunch of improvements for the party!

Some of the highlights: 
[i](Cause the dev couldn't be bothered to write down all the many things he improved)[/i]

[list]
[*] Fixed bug where grabbing items / NPC's would sometimes cause them to get stuck inside a player's body
[*] Added full controller support for Xbox & PlayStation controllers
[*] Added improved settings menu
[*] Added new sound effects
[/list]
